_doc: Causes valid for every crop (hosts ['*']). `desc` = Laya option text. `criteria` = L5 yes/no checks used for clarification questions. `photo` = expected vision.py signals; `conditions` = weather/sensor conditions that make the cause more likely; `advice` = DAG edges to kb/strategies.json with evidence state (Supp, Part, Uncert, Unk, Contra).

causes.desc: nitrogen shortage: older lower leaves uniformly pale yellow from the tip along the midrib, whole crop pale and slow, needs urea

criteria.en: Did the yellowing start on the older, lower leaves?
criteria.hi: क्या पीलापन नीचे की पुरानी पत्तियों से शुरू हुआ?

criteria.en: Does the yellow run from the leaf tip down the middle (V shape)?
criteria.hi: क्या पीलापन पत्ती की नोक से बीच की नस के साथ (V आकार में) है?

causes.desc: phosphorus shortage: young plants stunted with purple or reddish older leaves, worse in cold soil early in the season

criteria.en: Are the older leaves or stems purple or reddish?
criteria.hi: क्या पुरानी पत्तियाँ या तना बैंगनी/लाल हैं?

criteria.en: Is the crop young and has the weather been cold?
criteria.hi: क्या फसल छोटी है और मौसम ठंडा रहा है?

causes.desc: potassium shortage: edges and tips of older leaves turn yellow then brown and scorched, weak stems and lodging

criteria.en: Are the edges of the older leaves brown and dry while the centre stays green?
criteria.hi: क्या पुरानी पत्तियों के किनारे भूरे-सूखे हैं और बीच का भाग हरा है?

causes.desc: magnesium shortage: yellow between green veins on older leaves (striped or marbled), sometimes reddish

criteria.en: Are the veins green with yellow between them on the older leaves?
criteria.hi: क्या पुरानी पत्तियों पर नसें हरी और बीच का भाग पीला है?

causes.desc: zinc shortage: young leaves with rusty brown spots or white bands near the base (khaira in paddy, white bud in maize), stunted plants with short internodes

criteria.en: Are the new, younger leaves affected first?
criteria.hi: क्या नई पत्तियाँ पहले प्रभावित हुईं?

criteria.en: Are there rusty brown patches or broad white bands on the leaves?
criteria.hi: क्या पत्तियों पर कत्थई धब्बे या चौड़ी सफेद पट्टियाँ हैं?

causes.desc: iron shortage: youngest leaves pale yellow to white with sharply green veins, common in high-pH or waterlogged soils and in hydroponics with high pH

criteria.en: Are the youngest leaves yellow-white with clearly green veins?
criteria.hi: क्या सबसे नई पत्तियाँ पीली-सफेद और नसें साफ हरी हैं?

causes.desc: sulphur shortage: whole young leaves uniformly pale yellow-green including the veins, common in mustard, pulses and sandy soils

criteria.en: Are the young leaves evenly pale, veins included?
criteria.hi: क्या नई पत्तियाँ नसों सहित एक समान हल्की पीली हैं?

causes.desc: too much fertiliser or salty water: leaf tips and edges burnt brown soon after heavy fertiliser, white crust on soil, very high EC in nutrient solution

criteria.en: Did the burning start within a few days of applying fertiliser?
criteria.hi: क्या खाद डालने के कुछ दिन में ही पत्तियाँ जलीं?

causes.desc: waterlogging: whole field or low patches turned yellow after heavy rain or over-irrigation with standing water, roots brown or black

criteria.en: Has water been standing in the field for more than a day recently?
criteria.hi: क्या हाल में खेत में एक दिन से ज़्यादा पानी भरा रहा?

criteria.en: Is it worse in the low-lying parts of the field?
criteria.hi: क्या खेत के निचले हिस्से में ज़्यादा असर है?

causes.desc: drought or missed irrigation: leaves rolled or drooping in the afternoon and recovering at night, dry cracked soil

criteria.en: Do the plants droop in the afternoon but look fine in the early morning?
criteria.hi: क्या दोपहर में पौधे मुरझाते हैं और सुबह ठीक दिखते हैं?

causes.desc: frost or cold injury: leaves suddenly water-soaked then black or bleached after a very cold clear night in winter (pala)

criteria.en: Did it appear suddenly after a very cold night?
criteria.hi: क्या यह बहुत ठंडी रात के बाद अचानक दिखा?

causes.desc: heat stress: leaf scorching, flower and fruit drop and poor grain setting during very hot dry winds (loo) above about 35 to 40 degrees

criteria.en: Has it been very hot (above about 38 °C) recently?
criteria.hi: क्या हाल में बहुत गर्मी (लगभग 38 °C से ज़्यादा) रही?

causes.desc: hail or storm: leaves torn and shredded, bruised fruits, plants bent or lodged after a storm

criteria.en: Did a hailstorm or strong storm happen just before this?
criteria.hi: क्या ठीक पहले ओले या तेज़ आंधी आई थी?

causes.desc: herbicide or spray injury: bleached, twisted or burnt leaves a few days after spraying, following the spray path or drift from a neighbour

criteria.en: Was anything sprayed on or near this field in the last week?
criteria.hi: क्या पिछले हफ्ते इस खेत में या पास में कोई दवा छिड़की गई?

causes.name_hi: निचली पत्तियों का सामान्य रूप से पकना
causes.desc: normal: only the oldest bottom leaves yellow and dry while the crop is filling grain or near maturity; the rest of the plant is healthy

criteria.en: Is the crop at grain filling or close to harvest?
criteria.hi: क्या फसल दाना भरने या कटाई के नज़दीक है?

criteria.en: Are only the bottom 1-3 leaves affected, the rest green?
criteria.hi: क्या सिर्फ नीचे की 1-3 पत्तियाँ प्रभावित हैं और बाकी हरी हैं?

causes.desc: healthy: green, growing well, at most a few cosmetic marks; the farmer only wants reassurance or general tips
